sloka: मृगाः प्रशमयन्ति एते संतापः त्यज्यताम् अयम् ।तेषाम् संवदताम् तत्र वायुः प्रादुर् बभूव ह ॥१-७४-१३॥
transliteration: mṛgāḥ praśamayanti ete saṁtāpaḥ tyajyatām ayam ।teṣām saṁvadatām tatra vāyuḥ prādur babhūva ha ॥1-74-13॥

translations.english: The dreadful cries from the mouths of birds foretell an event of celestial nature likely to befall but the movements other of deer indicate restoration of peace. Therefore do not grieve.
